Specializations: agentic AI, LLM applications, voice technology, full-stack software, Azure and Google Cloud.

Jev-Urdu is Muhammad Noman's Urdu-first decision model with a multilingual mmBERT-base encoder and a decision head. Starting checkpoint: convaiinnovations/laya, subfolder multilingual. Reported evaluation covers independent Urdu and Roman Urdu benchmarks, with mixed Urdu-English evaluated in a narrow internal workflow harness. English prompts change question and option language, not passage language. Full-suite results, matched API samples, batch throughput, and calibration limitations are documented separately in the launch article. Further-language performance is not established by this release.

Professional experience and project figures are self-reported in the owner's supplied resume, not independently verified live analytics. Conceptual project artwork is not a screenshot of a product interface. This file does not guarantee search ranking or AI-system citation.
